owner: activation owns only a proven non-GC immediate such as null/undefined/boolean or an immediate number; no managed alias
root: no GC root required; stack map only for a boxed value, which is not S01
pin: not-needed; no address-sensitive use
carrier: SSA/register or stack value
escalation: compile error if a managed representation is put on the S01 carrier

owner: caller/activation owns object; aliases retain identity
root: GC-visible local/stack root while live
pin: not-needed for tagged access; reload after calls
carrier: managed heap object plus stack map
escalation: generic Tier 1 required if uniqueness cannot be proved

owner: caller owns identity; callback may retain or publish a managed alias
root: caller root plus callback/closure/queue root; promote on escape
pin: not-needed for managed alias; pin only for an explicit raw view
carrier: managed argument with heap promotion and GC roots
escalation: ordinary escape must promote/root; only an explicit raw/scoped borrow escape is a compile error

owner: caller remains owner; explicit mutable borrow is exclusive
root: owner root remains live through callback
pin: verified stable stack slot or stable external allocation; root alone is not a pin
carrier: stable slot or verified stable external allocation; close borrow before re-entry
escalation: unknown alias/re-entry or raw address without a stable carrier requires reload or compile error

case: explicit move in non-suspending lexical scope
owner: one source owner transfers to destination
root: destination root after commit; source root ends
pin: not-needed for ordinary move; destination raw address requires a separately named stable carrier
carrier: move into return slot, frame, or region; no callback/FFI/worker handoff
escalation: post-move source use, suspend, callback, or failed transfer requires another boundary row or a compile error

owner: source owner remains; clone gets independent owner
root: both roots until their last uses
pin: not-needed for managed copy; a raw clone address requires a separately named stable carrier
carrier: new managed allocation or defined copy carrier
escalation: copy failure or non-copyable defined behavior must use its error path

owner: parent owns record; projection is a borrow
root: parent root covers projection
pin: verified stable parent slot/external allocation or reload; root/handle alone is not a pin
carrier: parent handle plus offset reload or verified stable slot
escalation: parent move/shape change without reload or stable carrier is a compile error

owner: parent owns record; each projection is exclusive
root: parent root plus both projection roots/borrow tokens
pin: verified stable parent slot/external allocation with proven disjoint offsets; otherwise reload
carrier: field pins or parent stable external storage
escalation: overlap, dynamic property, unknown layout, or root-as-pin reasoning is a compile error for raw projections

owner: region owns allocations and borrows
root: region token/root remains until destruction
pin: region allocation stable for in-region address uses
carrier: scoped region/arena with reverse-order cleanup; no worker/FFI escape
escalation: region escape, suspension, worker/FFI handoff, or missing exceptional cleanup requires a boundary row or compile error

owner: caller owns buffer; foreign call borrows only
root: caller root through foreign return
pin: foreign-call pin covers exactly the call
carrier: stable stack slot or explicitly pinned external buffer
escalation: foreign retention or allocator mismatch is a compile error

owner: activation or continuation owns managed primitive value
root: stack map, continuation field, or strong GC handle while live
pin: not-needed for tagged use; stable address prohibited without a separate carrier
carrier: managed tagged value with visible root; reload after movement
escalation: unrooted managed primitive or raw address use without a stable carrier is a compile error

owner: caller owns value; contract grants a bounded raw/shared borrow
root: caller owner root remains live through callback
pin: stable stack slot or verified stable external allocation only through callback
carrier: explicit raw/scoped borrow contract; no ordinary managed alias semantics
escalation: raw borrow escape, suspension, or re-entry without a verified contract is a compile error

owner: continuation owns live local
root: continuation frame fields are strong roots
pin: verified stable continuation-frame address only if carrier guarantees it; otherwise reload
carrier: stable continuation frame or heap promotion
escalation: missing frame root or stable address carrier is a compile error

owner: caller initially owns input; continuation needs a new owner or copy
root: caller root cannot be assumed while suspended
pin: no stack pin across await; copy or verified stable promoted/external owner if view survives
carrier: copy, promoted owner, or continuation-owned handle
escalation: borrow-across-suspend without a root and actual stable carrier is a compile error

owner: atomic one-shot registration owns pending state until one winner
root: continuation, registration token, and callback root remain until winner claims
pin: pin not needed for managed state; callback must claim before dereference
carrier: continuation frame plus atomic pending/completed/cancelled registration
escalation: missing one-shot arbitration or losing late callback dereference is a compile error; a defined late race is not itself invalid

owner: generator owns source state; yielded result/consumer owns the exact view alias for retained use
root: generator object roots frame and backing store; returned view is a managed consumer root
pin: original JS view identity is preserved; no copy pin unless explicit stable carrier is proven
carrier: generator continuation plus managed heap view/backing store retained by consumer
escalation: copy is allowed only for explicit clone or unobservable internal bytes; identity/detach loss is a compile error

owner: Effect scope owns resource, finalizer, and child state
root: fiber/scope continuation roots resource and cause
pin: no stable pin from scope root; external resource address needs a separately verified stable carrier
carrier: scoped region plus continuation frame
escalation: missing finalizer ordering or stable resource carrier is a compile error

owner: child fiber owns value only after proven or explicit unique/move transfer
root: child fiber scheduler and join scope root the moved state
pin: no stable pin from fiber root; unique address use needs stable slot/external carrier
carrier: fiber-owned continuation/heap state; ordinary captured aliases use E05
escalation: parent use after a verified move or fork failure with two owners is a compile error

owner: join scope owns shared immutable value
root: all fibers and join scope are roots
pin: no stable pin for managed reads; address use needs a separately verified stable carrier
carrier: join-owned region or rooted immutable heap
escalation: mutation through a read proof is a compile error or generic path

owner: synchronized cell/scope owns shared mutable state
root: all participating fibers and finalizer root state
pin: no address pin; lock/atomicity synchronizes each operation only
carrier: atomic or synchronized cell; refcount only if independent
escalation: unsynchronized alias or unbalanced interruption cleanup is a compile error

case: ordinary captured JS alias across fork
owner: parent and child fibers share managed object identity
root: VM/parent/child fiber roots and any escaped closure/queue root
pin: not-needed for managed alias; raw address prohibited without a separate stable carrier
carrier: shared managed heap object with fiber roots and defined synchronization
escalation: inferring unique move from ordinary capture or unsynchronized mutation is a compile error

owner: FiberRuntime owns messages and observer registrations
root: fiber runtime, inbox queue, observer handles, and callback registrations root state
pin: no stable-address pin; callbacks claim one-shot token before use
carrier: fiber-owned inbox plus atomic one-shot observer/deregistration state
escalation: observer/inbox delivery after close must lose the claim and drop without dereferencing released fiber state

owner: fiber runtime owns inherited and locally updated FiberRef map
root: current fiber continuation and scope root the map
pin: not-needed for managed map; raw address requires separate stable carrier
carrier: persistent or copy-on-write FiberRef map owned by fiber runtime
escalation: fork inheritance, restore, or termination without a named map owner is a compile error

owner: scope owns finalizer stack, acquired resources, and child scopes
root: scope continuation and finalizer registration root resources
pin: no stable pin from scope root; external resource pin must be named
carrier: scoped region plus continuation frame and reverse-order finalizers
escalation: finalizer order, interruption cleanup, or child-scope release without an owner is a compile error

owner: waiter/message primitive owns queued nodes until handoff or drop
root: queue, subscriber, and waiter fiber roots pending nodes
pin: no raw pin; waiter callback claims one-shot state before payload access
carrier: heap queue plus atomic waiter completion and deregistration state
escalation: late waiter, subscriber, or dropped message must release its node without touching a closed fiber

owner: request registration owns pending request and resolver
root: Effect request queue, fiber continuation, and resolver root request state
pin: no stable pin; resolver uses claimed registration token
carrier: promoted request object plus atomic one-shot registration
escalation: request cancellation or late completion without one-shot arbitration is a compile error

owner: transaction owns journal, retry set, and retry todos
root: transaction continuation and STM registration root transaction state
pin: no stable pin; journal is reloaded from its owned heap carrier
carrier: fiber-local heap journal plus atomic retry registration
escalation: retry after commit/interrupt or journal release without an owner is a compile error

owner: executor scope owns child state, buffers, and pending demand
root: executor fiber, queue, and scope roots buffered values
pin: no stable pin for managed buffers; only explicitly stable external bytes may be pinned
carrier: heap-promoted executor/continuation plus owned buffer queue
escalation: buffer/view identity must be preserved; dropped demand must release without late callback dereference

owner: schedule registration owns timer and continuation wakeup
root: timer handle, scheduler, and fiber continuation root registration
pin: no stable pin; callback claims timer token before use
carrier: timer token plus atomic one-shot timer state
escalation: late timer after cancellation must be a no-op without released continuation access

owner: scope/runtime context owns service layer and teardown registrations
root: fiber, scope, and VM/worker context root layers
pin: no stable pin; service objects remain managed aliases
carrier: persistent context map plus scoped layer finalizers
escalation: layer replacement, duplicate context, or teardown without a named owner is a compile error

owner: VM/fiber service registry owns observers, spans, and test hooks
root: VM/worker context and observer registration root service state
pin: no stable pin; callback claims registration before touching service state
carrier: VM-scoped registry plus atomic one-shot observer tokens
escalation: observer/test callback after close must be dropped without dereferencing released registry state

owner: Micro continuation/result owner retains pending computation
root: microtask queue, promise, and fiber continuation root value
pin: no stable pin; reload managed result after safepoint
carrier: continuation frame plus microtask queue and one-shot settlement state
escalation: double settlement or late microtask dereference is a compile error

owner: VM/worker FiberRuntime owns explicit current-fiber ambient state
root: realm/worker runtime and active continuation root saved/restored state
pin: no stable pin; ambient identity is a managed handle, not an address carrier
carrier: explicit save/restore ambient operation scoped to FiberRuntime; no hidden global/TLS owner
escalation: missing save/restore, hidden global/thread-local state, or use after fiber close is a compile error

case: late Effect callback and observer race
owner: atomic one-shot registration owns callback payload until winner
root: registration token, fiber continuation, and callback handle root payload
pin: no stable pin; losing callback cannot dereference payload
carrier: atomic pending/completed/cancelled registration with claim-before-use
escalation: late callback is defined; only missing arbitration or post-loss dereference is a compile error

owner: foreign library owns returned buffer; caller has temporary borrow
root: foreign lifetime handle/contract roots owner while valid
pin: foreign pin or immediate copy covers use
carrier: foreign pin/handle or immediate owned copy
escalation: foreign validity interval or allocator is unknown: compile error

owner: registration/external allocation owns retained data
root: registration token and callback handle root data
pin: external allocation or foreign pin lasts to unregister and late callback
carrier: promoted external object plus registration token
escalation: retention, late callback, or release protocol missing: compile error

owner: native call frame and registration own active state
root: VM handles root callback, captures, and active state
pin: stable native frame or explicit external pin across callback
carrier: stable native frame plus GC handles
escalation: raw JSC pointer or mutable borrow across re-entry is a compile error

owner: cancellation token owns registration until delivery is impossible
root: registration and callback handles remain rooted through race
pin: no raw address pin; external allocation/foreign pin only until unregister acknowledgement or late delivery
carrier: registration token with synchronized close
escalation: release before late callback or double completion is a compile error

owner: activation/continuation owns live JS value
root: stack map or strong GC handle at every safepoint
pin: no pin for tagged use; reload after possible movement
carrier: managed value plus stack map/handle
escalation: unregistered live value is a compile error

owner: rooted owner remains responsible for object
root: strong GC handle or frame root; root is reachability only
pin: no stable pin is assumed for a moving JS object; prohibit raw address and reload from root
carrier: rooted handle/frame plus reloadable managed access; stable external allocation only when separately verified
escalation: Strong, DeferGC, or ordinary root cannot justify a stable address; raw use without an actual stable carrier is a compile error

owner: parent owner remains responsible for projected field
root: parent GC handle roots complete object; handle is not a pin
pin: no stable pin for a moving JS object; reload projection or use a separately stable external allocation
carrier: parent handle plus reload, or verified stable external field carrier
escalation: stale projection, unknown parent movement, or root-as-pin reasoning is a compile error

owner: registration owns callback and captured environment
root: GC registration/strong handle roots callback until deregistered
pin: pin only during synchronous callback; registration is not address pin
carrier: GC handle plus deregistration token
escalation: callback retention or deregistration exit is unclassified: compile error

owner: promoted heap object owns captured state
root: queue, closure, frame, or registration roots promotion
pin: verified stable external allocation only; moving managed heap requires reload
carrier: heap promotion plus GC handle
escalation: escape without promotion or release owner is a compile error

owner: GC owns target conditionally; WeakRef does not own it
root: no strong root until deref result is acquired
pin: no pin from weak reachability; a strong result still needs a separately verified stable carrier for raw address use
carrier: weak handle plus explicit strong result/root
escalation: using weak liveness as a borrow/root/pin is a compile error

owner: receiver owns new clone; sender retains source
root: queue roots clone while delivery is pending
pin: clone has independent address; no source pin transfer
carrier: structured-clone allocation plus queue root
escalation: clone failure or queue ownership is not represented: compile error

case: ArrayBuffer transfer list validation, commit, enqueue, delivery/drop
owner: validation owner leaves sender unchanged; committed token owns backing store; receiver owns only after delivery
root: transfer token/queue roots pending committed state; closed worker roots drop state
pin: no JS-heap pin needed for backing store; committed backing-store address remains with token/receiver
carrier: validation -> detach/ownership commit -> enqueue -> delivered|dropped transfer state machine
escalation: validation must not detach; post-detachment enqueue/delivery failure leaves sender detached and drops token; unmodeled transition is a compile error

owner: shared backing-store owner protocol spans workers
root: all worker handles and GC references root shared object
pin: stable shared storage; each access still obeys atomic/synchronization rules
carrier: shared GC handle plus atomic storage
escalation: non-atomic mutable alias or missing worker release is a compile error

owner: queue/port owns callback and captured environment
root: queue, port, and worker registration roots captures
pin: no raw cross-thread pin; external address use needs a separately verified stable allocation
carrier: heap-promoted closure plus thread/GC handle and atomic close state
escalation: stack borrow or JS-heap pointer crosses thread without carrier; late callback must lose claim without dereferencing closed state

owner: main and worker each own an independent native reference
root: thread-safe owner/refcount roots resource until final release
pin: stable external allocation or synchronized operation pin
carrier: reference count only with atomic protocol and named owners
escalation: an enclosing join/region exists, or synchronization/release is missing: compile error

owner: each WorkerContext owns its VM/global state and queue; parent owns child handle and explicit termination token
root: worker context, queue, port registrations, and child handle root pending work; nested child is independently rooted
pin: no raw cross-context pin; managed messages use roots and transfer tokens
carrier: worker context plus owned queue and atomic close/late-callback state machine
escalation: parent termination must not implicitly free nested child; closed queues drop/release work and late callbacks cannot dereference either context
